title: Where our data comes from
intro: Every number on KrishiBangla shows its source and when it was updated. Nothing is invented: if a source is unavailable we say so instead of showing a placeholder.

openMeteo.name: Open-Meteo
openMeteo.usedFor: Current weather, 7-day forecast, evapotranspiration and soil moisture for each district; irrigation advice.
openMeteo.frequency: Current conditions every 15 minutes; the forecast every hour.
openMeteo.terms: Data under CC BY 4.0. The free API is for non-commercial use.

tcb.name: Trading Corporation of Bangladesh (TCB)
tcb.usedFor: Today's retail prices of food in Dhaka city markets, with the prices a week, a month and a year earlier.
tcb.terms: Public information from TCB, a Government of Bangladesh agency; no specific licence is stated. TCB is credited as the source.

wfp.name: World Food Programme (WFP), via the Humanitarian Data Exchange
wfp.usedFor: Monthly retail prices of staple foods in markets across Bangladesh.
wfp.frequency: Monthly; published one to three months late.

worldBank.name: World Bank — World Development Indicators
worldBank.usedFor: National figures: agriculture's share of GDP, cereal and fish production, agricultural land and employment.
worldBank.frequency: Yearly; the latest year is often one or two years behind.

nasa.name: NASA POWER (Langley Research Center)
nasa.usedFor: Monthly temperature and rainfall compared with the long-term normal for each division.
nasa.terms: Free to use with acknowledgement of the NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project.

gdacs.name: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (UN and European Commission)
gdacs.usedFor: Cyclone, flood and drought alerts affecting Bangladesh.
gdacs.terms: Automatic estimates for awareness. Always follow official warnings from the Bangladesh Meteorological Department and the Department of Disaster Management.

geoBoundaries.name: geoBoundaries (district boundaries; original data from the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics and OCHA)

aiBody: The chat assistant and the disease scan use Google Gemini. AI answers can be wrong or out of date — check important decisions with your local Department of Agricultural Extension (DAE) office.
curatedBody: District profiles (main crops, soil, hazards) and crop guides are written by the KrishiBangla team as general guidance and are pending source review. They are marked as such wherever they appear.
